name: R-ShareMouse · 原入口兼容性检查
limitations: Native IPC rejects operations in this preview.
No daemon connection, discovery, pairing, input capture/injection, virtual display, audio, network gateway or file transfer is validated.
Narrow viewport records the original desktop layout and its clipping; it is not a mobile compatibility claim.
Large PNGs are losslessly represented as base64 text segments and reconstructed by the preview adapter.
